data.title: About Jaqueline
bio: As a REALTOR® Associate at Green Light Realty, Jaqueline helps buyers and sellers move forward across Central Jersey.
Whether you're buying your first home or selling to move up, Jaqueline walks you through pricing, neighborhoods, and next steps so nothing catches you off guard.
Reach out to Jaqueline for local market expertise and guidance from first conversation to closing day.
